usage: Used while designing the router prompt and validation rules. Scores on this set are not a measure of generalization.
description: Hand-labeled user messages for evaluating multi-agent intent routing. intent = what the user wants; status = whether the request can be executed directly or needs clarification first.

labels.order_only: Only asks about an order or its device information.
labels.knowledge_only: Technical question about a device, no order number.
labels.order_knowledge: Order number plus a technical or troubleshooting question, no ticket request.
labels.order_ticket: Order number plus a repair or return application, no troubleshooting request.
labels.order_knowledge_ticket: Order number, troubleshooting first, then a repair or return application.
labels.unclear: Greeting, out-of-scope request, or intent that cannot be mapped to a supported task.
